title: 联合国候选人：点破美国欠款创纪录，谁来买单？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The next Secretary-General is likely to face sustained financial pressures as it undergoes this reform.
segments.zh: 下一任秘书长在推进改革时，很可能持续面临财务压力。

segments.en: If you had to make a difficult choice, financially, what would you protect at the United Nations at all costs?
segments.zh: 如果必须做出艰难抉择，你会不惜一切代价保护联合国的什么？

segments.en: I don't agree with you. First of all, because if we start by saying first, but is everything that we are going to cut
segments.zh: 我不同意。如果一开始就想着削减或停止什么，我们会陷入最糟的境地。

segments.en: or stop to do, we will be in the worst situation.
segments.zh: 我经历过很多财务谈判，相信我，这不是第一步。

segments.en: I have negotiated a lot in financial scenarios, believe me, that's not the first thing you do.
segments.zh: 首先，我们要基于刚通过的关于联合国流动性问题的决议，因为财务危机与政治危机相关。

segments.en: First of all, we have to build on the resolution that just passed here on the liquidity crisis of the UN and convenes because I think that the financial crisis is linked to the
segments.zh: 所以我们必须保护核心、宪章和成员国，但也要更灵活，交付更好成果，产生更大影响。

segments.en: political crisis of the organization. So we have to protect the center, we have to protect the charter, we have to protect the republics, but we have to be more agile, we have to be able to deliver better results,
segments.zh: 明智使用资源，证明我们能最好地利用纳税人的钱。但不要一开始就放弃，那是战略问题。

segments.en: have more impact, and use our resources wisely to convince that we are able to use the taxpayers
segments.zh: 即使许多资源被扣留，目前联合国欠款数额，尤其是美国欠款，是前所未有的。

segments.en: resources in the best way possible. But don't start by giving up, that will be about strategy.
segments.zh: 以最佳方式利用资源，但不要一开始就放弃，这关乎策略。

segments.en: But even when many of those resources are being withheld, the amount of arrears right now to the UN, particularly by the United States, is unprecedented.
segments.zh: 但即便许多资源被扣留，目前联合国收到的欠款，尤其是美国的欠款，数额前所未有。
